description: Bridge USDC across chains using Circle's CCTP V2 protocol. Supported chains: base, ethereum, optimism, arbitrum, polygon, avalanche, linea, unichain, sonic, worldchain. The bridge approves USDC, burns on source, polls Circle IRIS for attestation, then mints on destination.

amount.description: Amount of USDC to bridge (human-readable, e.g. "100")

name: bridge_usdc
